# Faultline

> Faultline is an open-source (MIT), modern frontend for self-hosted GlitchTip, the Sentry-compatible error tracker. It is built to replace the stock GlitchTip UI completely (coverage is tracked in the parity checklist): issues, uptime monitors and status pages, performance, logs, releases, alerts, organisation and project settings, and sign-in with MFA and social logins. It ships as one Docker image (`ghcr.io/snnbotchway/faultline`) that serves the app and proxies the GlitchTip backend on the same origin. It is not affiliated with GlitchTip.

Install: `docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -e BACKEND_URL=http://<glitchtip-host>:8000 ghcr.io/snnbotchway/faultline`, then set GlitchTip's `GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN` to Faultline's URL. The GlitchTip backend stays unmodified, and Faultline keeps GlitchTip's URL paths, so existing alert links work.
